release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.4 Drop Panel & Beam Formwork Governance & Intersecting Beam Anchor Alignment:
• Drop Panel vs Beam Formwork Governance: Respects RAM Concept 2D mesh priority rules where standard beams (mesh_as_slab=False) defer to deeper drop panel soffits for formwork and tendon profiling.
• Intersecting Beam Anchor Alignment: When tendons anchor where longitudinal and transverse beams intersect, tendon anchor callouts and chairs correctly rest on the longitudinal beam the tendon runs inside.
• Accurate Anchor Top & Bottom Covers: Resolved top cover calculation ensuring exact callouts (e.g. CL 175* / 825mm chair in 1000mm drops, CL 75* / 625mm chair in 700mm beams).
• ProfileViewer Beam Alignment: Cross-section viewer samples longitudinal beams matching tendon tangent direction.
